prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, industry, channels, and how much you want AI to drive strategy vs. execution. That said, here’s a practical way to proceed plus a short list of reputable LA agencies and AI-native vendors you can evaluate.

If you want me to recommend specific firms tailored to you, tell me: budget, primary channels (social, search, display, email, site personalization), industry, and main KPI (sales, leads, LTV, brand lift).

Shortlist of LA options to consider
- R/GA (LA) — strong at product-focused creative, data/tech integration and experimentation. Good for brand + tech-led growth.
- AKQA (LA) — premium creative + experience design with data/ML capabilities for personalization.
- VaynerMedia (LA) — social-first performance + creative with experimentation and data teams.
- TBWA\Chiat\Day (LA) / 72andSunny (LA) — big-idea creative agencies that have analytics and tech teams; better for brand campaigns that also want data-informed targeting.
- Razorfish (global, LA presence) — digital experience, programmatic and CRM-driven marketing.
- AI-native platforms/agencies to pair or consider (often plug into agency workflows): Albert (autonomous media buying), Persado or Phrasee (AI language optimization), Cortex/Pattern89-type tools (creative optimization & testing).

How to pick the “best” for your needs
1. Define the objective and KPIs (ROAS, CAC, LTV, revenue lift, engagement).  
2. Ask for relevant case studies with measurable results in your industry.  
3. Confirm the tech stack and data requirements (will they use your first‑party data? integrate with your CDP/CRM?).  
4. Check sample workflows: do they run A/B tests, holdout tests, or proof‑of‑concept pilots?  
5. Understand pricing and success fees (flat retainer vs. performance share).  
6. Ask about transparency, auditability, and compliance/privacy practices.  
7. Start with a short pilot (30–90 days) with clear success metrics.

Quick next steps I can do for you
- Recommend 3 LA agencies matched to your needs (tell me goals, budget, channels).  
- Draft a short RFP/pilot brief you can send to agencies.  
- List specific questions to vet their AI capabilities and data practices.

Which would you like me to do?
